verdict.rationale: Raygun documents alert delivery to email, Slack or Teams with 'custom alerts' (pricing page). Its APM docs describe Slack channel authorization and PagerDuty incidents created when 'an issue is triggered from this rule', so the destinations and some rule-based triggering exist. There is no evidence of routing by project, environment or severity, or of per-rule thresholds; spike protection concerns usage volume, not alert triggers. missing for 10: routing by project/environment/severity, per-rule thresholds for new issue, frequency spike and affected-user count, crash-reporting (not only APM) PagerDuty/Slack rule docs, independent corroboration.
